text: 10 OVERDOSAGE There is no specific antidote for DAURISMO. Management of DAURISMO overdose should include symptomatic treatment and ECG monitoring. Glasdegib has been administered in clinical studies up to a dose of 640 mg/day. At the highest dosage, the adverse reactions that were dose limiting were nausea, vomiting, dehydration, hypotension, fatigue, and dizziness.
